# Introduction to Unmanned Aerial Systems

## Outline

* overview of UAS technology, system's classifications
* UAS components and operations
* UAS applications
* in class demonstration of selected systems (hands-on look at the program's aircraft; no flying)

## Lecture

* Lecture Slides: [Introduction to UAS](lectures/lecture_1a.qmd)
* Lecture Recording: [Fall 2024]({{< var recordings.topic1.lecture1a >}}) (NCSU Only)

## Supplemental materials

### Systems

#### Fixed wing and VTOL hybrid

* [eBee X by AgEagle](https://ageagle.com/drones/ebee-x/) (successor of the senseFly eBee used in earlier offerings of this course)
* [WingtraOne GEN II](https://wingtra.com/mapping-drone-wingtraone/)

#### Rotary wing

- [DJI Mavic 3 Enterprise / Multispectral](https://enterprise.dji.com/mavic-3-enterprise)
- [DJI Matrice 4 Series](https://enterprise.dji.com/matrice-4-series)
- [Skydio X10](https://www.skydio.com/x10) (NDAA-compliant, [Blue UAS](https://www.diu.mil/blue-uas) listed)
- [Freefly Astro](https://freeflysystems.com/astro) (NDAA-compliant, Blue UAS listed)

## Assignment

* [Assignment 1A: UAS systems and applications](assignments/assignment_1a.qmd) - select one UAS, research it, and present it to the class. See the assignment page for the full list of required elements, presentation format, and submission instructions.
